messages:
Harper: Tiny holiday idea: 'Badge & Cookie Station' next Thu at HQ 11-12. Make a free pin-badge, grab a cookie, write a 6-word winter wish for a wall. Sign up if youre coming or can drop badges/stickers. :pinched_fingers: :cookie:
Noah: Absolutely. Can we do a mini craft table for pin assembly? I have a hole punch and some spare backing cards.
Rina: I'll bring icing pens and gluten-free cookie options. Also can run a tiny sticker print if people want a custom Redwood winter badge.
Owen: Can someone make a quick sign-up? Im remote but can send a care cookie to my SF buddy. Internationalers: want a "cookie swap" opt-out?
Harper: Good call on opt-outs. Sign-up sheet columns: `Slack handle`, `In-person (Y/N)`, `Cookie allergy notes`, `Badge or sticker?`, `Willing to craft (Y/N)`, `Send internationally (Y/N)`. Link: http://tiny.redwood/badge-station (placeholder)
Felix: I can drop off 50 backing cards and a stack of enamel pin blanks. Also happy to coordinate packaging. :package: 
HolidayBot: Reminder scheduled: "Badge & Cookie Station setup" Thu 9:30 AM HQ. :bell:
Noah: Mini poll: cookie flavour for the table? React with :chocolate_bar: for chocolate chip, :lemon: for lemon shortbread, :ginger: for ginger snaps.
Rina: Added PDF for badge template and sticker art in the sheet. Will post final print-ready in the #design channel later today.
Harper: We'll also have a tiny '6-word winter wishes' wall. If you're remote, drop your six words in thread and we'll print them. Example: 'Warm lights, clean inboxes, cozy plants.'
Owen: Six words from me: 'Hot tea, quiet snow, friendly code reviews.'
Felix: Love it. Can we have a small kudos stack too? Folks can write a quick thanks on a tag.
Harper: Yes please 10: kudos tags will be by the table. Sign-ups close Tue EOD so we can print badges and order GF cookies. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
